name: teamstation
author: Paul Puey <paul@teamstation.app>
description: TeamStation — a platform for youth sports team management, scoring, and video streaming

scripts.build: node scripts/chatCryptoBuild.mjs node && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p lib/server/stats/fixtures lib/server/location lib/server/tess && cp src/server/stats/fixtures/*.json lib/server/stats/fixtures/ && cp src/server/location/placesCatalog.json.gz lib/server/location/ && cp src/server/tess/sitemap.generated.json lib/server/tess/ && mkdir -p lib/common/chatCrypto/node && rm -f lib/common/chatCrypto/node/chat_crypto.node && cp src/common/chatCrypto/node/chat_crypto.node lib/common/chatCrypto/node/
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage.scripts && npm run coverage.app && npm run coverage.server && npm run coverage.changed.server && npm run coverage.umpires
scripts.coverage.chat-ui: c8 --temp-directory coverage/chatUi/tmp --reports-dir coverage/chatUi --reporter=text --reporter=json --reporter=json-summary --exclude '**/*.test.*' --exclude '**/*.e2e.*' --exclude 'src/test/**' --exclude-after-remap node scripts/chatUiCoverage.mjs && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --base "$TS_COVERAGE_BASE" --coverage coverage/chatUi/coverage-final.json --report coverage/chatUi/changed-lines.json --ext .ts --ext .tsx --ext .mjs --ext .cjs --exclude src/app/locales/en_US.ts --exclude src/app/chat/screenEngine.ts --exclude src/app/components/glassViewProps.ts src scripts/chatUiCoverage.mjs scripts/changed-line-check.cjs
scripts.coverage.app: node scripts/chatCryptoBuild.mjs node wasm && node scripts/build-scoring-tests.mjs && node scripts/scoring-coverage.mjs
scripts.coverage.changed.app: c8 --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/changedApp --include 'src/app/player/**/*.ts' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --exclude '**/*.e2e.ts' --exclude '**/*.integration.ts' mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs --extension ts --spec 'src/app/player/**/*.test.ts' && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --coverage coverage/changedApp/coverage-final.json --ext .ts --allow-empty src/app/player
scripts.coverage.changed.server: node scripts/chatCryptoBuild.mjs node wasm && node scripts/server-changed-coverage.mjs
scripts.coverage.scripts: c8 --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/scripts --include 'scripts/changed-line-*.cjs' --include scripts/swift-changed-line-coverage.cjs mocha -r sucrase/register --extension ts --spec src/test/changedLineCoverage.test.ts --spec src/test/coverageScripts.test.ts --spec src/test/userIdCoverage.test.ts && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --coverage coverage/scripts/coverage-final.json --ext .cjs scripts/changed-line-coverage.cjs scripts/changed-line-check.cjs scripts/swift-changed-line-coverage.cjs
scripts.coverage.server: node src/migrate/requirePostgres18.js && node scripts/chatCryptoBuild.mjs node wasm && c8 --all --reporter=text --check-coverage --lines 90 --include src/common/userIdNumber.ts --include src/server/db/int8.ts --include src/common/gumboEventTypes.ts --include src/common/gumboPlay.ts --include src/server/events/**/*.ts --include --include src/server/teams/teamNames.ts --include src/common/scheduleGames.ts --include 'src/server/schedule/**/*.ts' --include src/server/routes/schedule.ts --include 'src/server/socket/*.ts' --include src/common/roles.ts --include src/common/playerSettings.ts --include src/server/access.ts --include src/server/invites/people.ts --include src/server/routes/manage.ts --include src/server/routes/me.ts --include src/server/routes/deviceEventControl.ts --include src/server/auth/deviceEventControl.ts --include src/server/routes/players.ts src/server/dev/replaySeed.ts mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs --extension ts --spec 'src/**/*.test.ts' --ignore '**/node_modules/**' --ignore 'lib/**'
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: node src/migrate/requirePostgres18.js && node scripts/chatCryptoBuild.mjs node wasm && node scripts/build-scoring-tests.mjs && node scripts/checkScoringLayering.mjs && mocha --timeout 20000 --exit -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs --extension ts --spec 'src/**/*.test.ts' --spec lib/scoring-tests.cjs --ignore '**/node_modules/**'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.eventControl.json
scripts.test.eventControl: tsc -p tsconfig.eventControl.json && c8 --all --reporter=text --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/eventControl --include 'tools/eventControl/**/*.ts' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --check-coverage --lines 90 mocha -r sucrase/register --extension ts --exit --timeout 15000 --spec 'tools/eventControl/**/*.test.ts' && node scripts/checkEventControlContract.cjs
scripts.test:builds-ui: node scripts/build-builds-ui-tests.mjs && mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs lib/builds-tests.cjs src/common/distribution.test.ts src/app/navigation/routes.test.ts
scripts.coverage.deploy: c8 --all --include 'scripts/deploy.ts' --include 'scripts/deploy/**/*.ts' --include 'scripts/clientConfig.mjs' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --report-dir coverage/deploy --reporter text --reporter json --reporter lcov --check-coverage --per-file --lines 90 mocha -r sucrase/register --timeout 15000 'scripts/deploy/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:portable: npm run test.eventControl && npm run test:deploy && npm run test:hosting && node --test scripts/coverage-provenance.test.cjs
scripts.coverage.mason: c8 --all --include Masonfile.ts --include scripts/deploy/mason.ts --report-dir coverage/mason --reporter text --reporter json --check-coverage --per-file --lines 90 mocha -r sucrase/register --timeout 15000 scripts/deploy/masonEntry.test.ts
